name: Theodore Roosevelt Lake Bridge
facts: The Theodore Roosevelt Lake Bridge, completed in 1992, replaced traffic over the lake dam, allowing two-way flow where the dam could only support one lane due to widening Model‑T cars.
In 1995, the bridge earned a spot among the top twelve U.S. bridge designs, celebrated as North America’s longest two‑lane, single‑span steel‑arch bridge.
Originally painted sky blue, the bridge’s paint has faded to a crisp white, a visual reminder of its 1992 $21.3 million construction by Edward Kraemer & Sons.
